outcome: Hypoplasia of the right portal vein
cohort: The study included 3 full-term newborns diagnosed with congenital portosystemic shunt during pregnancy or the neonatal period at a Tunisian referral center.
finding: Congenital portosystemic shunts can be diagnosed prenatally or neonatally and present with a wide range of associated anomalies and complications, including structural malformations, pulmonary hypertension, and hematological issues.
